title: Real Research Today: Fluidic Computing Chips
definition: Today's documented research behind Fluidic Computing Chips.
description:
The road to Fluidic Computing Chips is already being paved. DNA data storage (Microsoft/University of Washington) encodes digital data in synthetic DNA. The EU Quantum Flagship and US National Quantum Initiative fund quantum networking research.

Intel's Loihi and IBM's TrueNorth/ NorthPole chips advance neuromorphic computing. Together these programs form the channel networks foundation that Fluidic Computing Chips will build on — the chip logistics results, the droplet logic methods, and the institutional memory.

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as chip logistics research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

title: Fluidic Computing Chips Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Fluidic Computing Chips: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Fluidic Computing Chips — microfluidic chips computing with flows.

Phase 1 — Prove (channel networks): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (chip logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (droplet logic): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (lab integration): chip hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and labs-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
